description: This Python source file provides utilities for debugging, reproducing, and minifying issues related to the AOTI (Ahead of Time with Inductor) compilation process in the PyTorch framework. It includes functions to generate reproducible scripts, handle exported programs, and facilitate error diagnosis in the PyTorch compilation pipeline.
